name: homekeeper
description: HomeKeeper: your home's memory on Alexa+. MCP server on AWS.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @homekeeper/ui && npm run build -w @homekeeper/server && npm run build -w @homekeeper/simulator
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @homekeeper/ui && concurrently -n server,sim -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @homekeeper/server" "npm run dev -w @homekeeper/simulator"
scripts.bundle: npm run build -w @homekeeper/ui && npm run bundle -w @homekeeper/server
scripts.deploy: npm run bundle && npm run deploy -w @homekeeper/infra
